notes: IP extractor switch on Domain and Exclude nodes (matches by address without changing Windows DNS). DNS: no longer left on 127.0.0.1 after a restart, only taken while a route that needs it is connected, and lookups no longer wait for a server that does not answer. A site behind a shared CDN address stays in Exclude. Hover a node for 2 seconds to see what it does. Network tab marks Windows system processes and VPN apps; system processes can only be speed-limited, and a VPN app is never sent into its own tunnel. Faster service start.
